profile.name: Anshul Gora
profile.tagline: I build useful software, write to clarify what I learn, and keep looking for simpler ways to solve hard problems.
profile.about_text:
I’m a developer who enjoys turning ambiguous ideas into clear, dependable digital products. I work across the stack, with a particular interest in React interfaces, Node.js services, and the small details that make software feel considered.

I care about readable code, accessible experiences, and shipping work that solves a real problem. My process usually moves from understanding the user and the constraint to building a focused first version, then refining it with feedback.

Outside of client work, I experiment with new tools, document what I learn, and look for better ways to make the web faster, simpler, and more useful.
